A colossal crimson-and-gold fire dragon glowing with inner heat, molten light leaking between armored scales, twin black horns and a spined crest, vast leathery wings half-furled over the gold, a long spiked tail coiled through the treasure.

An ancient obsidian-black dragon, matte scales edged with ember-red, a crown of back-swept horns, smoldering amber eyes, blood-red wing-membranes draped over the hoard, smoke curling from its nostrils as it sleeps.

A scarred old bronze dragon green with verdigris and age, broad battered horns, notched wing-membranes folded tight over the gold, coins fused to its underbelly scales, a vast muscular tail buried deep in the treasure.

A frost-white dragon rimed in ice, translucent scales gleaming like polished bone, long crystalline horns branching like antlers, pale blue wing-membranes laced with frost-veins, a coiling tail trailing ice crystals across frozen golden coins.

A deep-emerald dragon with thick mossy plates along its spine, blunt curved horns overgrown with lichen, heavy reptilian skull lowered over the hoard, vast dark-green wings spread like ancient canopies, a long tail crushing chalices underfoot.

A molten-veined dragon, charcoal-grey scales cracked along every ridge to reveal rivers of orange lava-light beneath, stubby obsidian horns, vast scorched wings furled over a hoard fused into glass, heat-shimmer rising from its bulk.

A regal violet-purple dragon with iridescent scale-tips catching torchlight, a feathered bony crest running crown to shoulders, swept ivory horns, wide wing-membranes the color of bruised storm-cloud draped heavy over a mountain of jewels.

A massive sapphire-blue dragon, each scale edged with silver like scales of moonlit water, twin spiraling horns of pale bone, electric-blue wing-membranes folded half-open over the hoard, a muscular tail ringed in silver bands.

A sun-yellow dragon scaled like hammered gold leaf, short thick amber horns above a broad reptilian skull, narrow slitted pupils black as pitch, vast tawny wings folded flush to its flanks, tail coiled in loose rings through coins.

A battle-scarred grey-green wyrm-king, dulled scales pocked with old lance-wounds, a broken left horn and one intact curved right, ragged wing-membranes stitched with scar tissue, a ponderous tail flattening armor beneath it on the hoard.

A copper-and-bronze hoard-tyrant burnished to a warm ruddy sheen, broad ridged horns curling outward like a ram, thick scaled neck lowered protectively, enormous wings half-furled and gleaming like hammered metal over cascading coins and crown.

A midnight-indigo dragon dusted with faint silver specks like a night sky, slender backward-swept horns, eyes like pale white moons, vast dark wing-membranes blotting the cavern ceiling, a long thin tail spiraling down through the gold.

A soot-black albino dragon with chalk-white underbelly scales and pink-rimmed pale eyes, vestigial horn-nubs above a heavy brow, enormous ragged smoke-grey wings draped like a shroud over the hoard, tail tipped with a bony club.

A rust-red-and-iron dragon scaled like overlapping shield-plates, a double row of serrated dorsal horns from skull to tail-tip, stocky four-legged frame crouched low, wide rust-membrane wings spread over piled weapons and coins, breath a yellow acid mist.

A sea-teal dragon with iridescent nacre scales rippling green-to-blue in shifting light, long curved ivory horns swept back like seashell spirals, vast translucent aqua wing-membranes folded over the hoard, a serpentine tail ending in a broad fin-like fan.

A pale-gold albino dragon bleached to near-white with faint gilt undertones, hairline scales so fine they look like skin, two long straight ivory horns, enormous thin-boned cream wings spread low and wide over the glittering hoard.

A hulking forest-brown dragon armored in rough bark-textured scales, gnarled antler-like horns twisted and branching, four heavy clawed legs planted deep in treasure, vast earthy-brown wings half-raised, a blunt tail smashing goblets into the stone floor.

A deep-charcoal dragon veined throughout with bioluminescent violet, every scale-edge glowing cold purple, twin straight obsidian horns, skull angular and severe, wide dark wings lit from within by crawling violet light draped over the golden hoard.

A pale-silver dragon aged to a white-grey sheen, fine overlapping scales like chainmail, long tapering horns slightly translucent at the tips, enormous silver-membrane wings spread wide over a hoard of mirrors and plate-armor, pupils pale and cold.

A forest-green-and-black mottled dragon with irregular dark blotching across its hide, stubby recurved black horns, thick ridged underbelly plates, broad membranous wings marked with dark vein-patterns folded over the treasure, a heavy tail sweeping coins aside.

A tyrant red-and-black banded dragon, crimson scales banded with jet-black rings like a venomous serpent made mountainous, paired swept-back horns black as coal, massive four-legged frame low over the hoard, vast dark-red wings half-furled and trembling.

A chalk-white glacier dragon with scales etched by centuries of ice, cracked spiraling horns rimmed with hoarfrost, sunken blue eyes glowing faintly, enormous pale wing-membranes laced with blue frost-cracks draped over a hoard locked in clear ice.

A deep-burgundy wine-dark dragon, scales shimmering from near-black to deep red in shifting light, long tapered ivory horns, a heavy ridged brow, vast burgundy-membrane wings half-furled over spilled goblets and ruby-studded crowns on the hoard.

A mottled olive-and-ochre desert dragon, scales cracked and sand-worn, flat broad horns like curved stone slabs, four squat powerful legs sunk into a hoard mixed with desert-bleached bones, vast dun-yellow wings spread like dried hide over the gold.

A colossal ash-grey dragon shot through with threads of deep blue, scales like rough volcanic rock, twin broad flat horns chipped at the edges, cold silver eyes, enormous dark ashen wings draping the full length of the hoard like a collapsed storm-cloud.
